note: Rustic family campground off Co Rd H-15 near Shingleton, east of Munising and Pictured Rocks, with on-site trail access for hikers, side-by-sides, motorcycles, Jeeps and snowmobiles (the UP200 sled-dog race runs along the rail grade on site). Hand-pump water; a picnic table and fire ring per site; gravel/grass pads. A listing gives a 30-ft site cap, but reviewers report 40-ft fifth wheels fitting. A cabin for 10 is rented separately. --Claude
